---
title: "link-external: invalid filter"
# bd-t3n1nghb: a filter that Rust's regex cannot compile (look-ahead is
# JavaScript-only) warns Q-13-14 and is ignored; links are still
# classified without it.
format:
  html:
    link-external-icon: true
    link-external-filter: '^https://(?!example\.com)'
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: "Invalid link-external-filter"
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['a.external[href="https://example.com/"]', 'a.external[href="https://example.org/"]']
        - []
---

[One](https://example.com/) and [two](https://example.org/).
